messages.subject: Can't load data to worker nodes, running SparkR on EC2
messages.subject_clean: Can't load data to worker nodes, running SparkR on EC2
messages.body_plain:
Let me start with the error message, then I'll post the console output from a previous step that I think highlights the problem.

This is running RStudio locally on my laptop, connecting to an EC2 cluster that spun up using the EC2 script that comes with the 1.4 release of Spark.

messages.body_plain:
It looks like Spark is somehow not installed correctly / running
correctly on these machines. Does the Scala shell / PySpark work on
this cluster ?

BTW since SparkR development has moved to the Apache repository it'll
be better to post questions to the Spark user mailing lists (See
http://spark.apache.org/community.html)

Thanks
Shivaram
